about: Quispamsis is a town in the Kennebecasis Valley of southern New Brunswick, northeast of Saint John toward Rothesay. Residential neighbourhoods, lakes, and valley parks define a growing suburb in Greater Saint John, with shopping and schools shared across the twin-town area. About 19,000 people live in Quispamsis.
